item.title: Alex Neil prepares for North Wales trip
item.description: Millwall head to Wrexham for the first time since 2001 this Saturday. Ahead of The Lions taking on The Red Dragons in a top-six clash (kick-off 3.01pm), Head Coach Alex Neil sat down with Millwall TV+ to preview the meeting. Below, hear from the Scot as he discusses the recent arrivals of Tommy Watson and Anthony Patterson, his admiration for Phil Parkinson's side, team news for the weekend and much more.

item.title: Preview | Wrexham v Millwall
item.description: Millwall travel to Wrexham in the Sky Bet Championship on Saturday afternoon (kick-off 3.01pm). The Lions begin the first of two consecutive away games by taking on the side one place and three points below them in the division's top six, looking to get back to winning ways on the road after a valiant and narrow defeat at League leaders Coventry City last time out. item.title: Lions bag priceless away win at Wrexham
item.description: Millwall were 2-0 winners at Wrexham in the Sky Bet Championship on Saturday afternoon. A Max Cleworth own-goal opened the scoring at SToK Cae Ras, before Josh Coburn stepped off the bench to lash home the second with five minutes to play and secure a brilliant away win. Alex Neil made one change to his starting line-up for the trip to North Wales, as Barry Bannan came in for his first Millwall start in place of Macaulay Langstaff, who dropped to the bench. item.title: A vital clean sheet for Coops and Millwall
item.description: A monstrous defensive performance at SToK Rae Cas. Alongside Caleb Taylor, Jake Cooper kept Wrexham quiet in Saturday's 2-0 win in North Wales - and The Lions' captain spoke to Millwall TV+ after the victory, with his post-match interview now available below. Click play to hear from Coops as he praises the travelling fans and more.
